title: Abraham's justification by faith, not works
english: What then shall we say Abraham found? If Abraham was justified by works, he has glory—but not with God. Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness (Romans 4:1-3).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is explaining Paul's argument that Abraham was justified by faith, not by works, so he has no ground for boasting before God.

title: Blessed are those whose sins are forgiven
english: Blessed are those whose iniquities have been forgiven (Romans 4:7). This blessedness belongs to the uncircumcision: faith is reckoned as righteousness without works of the law. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is commenting on Romans 4, where Paul quotes David's words about the blessedness of the forgiven, and Origen applies this blessedness to the uncircumcised who are justified by faith.
